title: receive_bytes silently resets on fragment parse failure when done
description:
Location: rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs:821-823

Issue:
```rust
Err(_) if self.done => Ok(ReceiverResult::default()),
Err(_) => Ok(self.abort(rule_id)),
```

When the receiver is in `done` state and receives a malformed fragment, it silently returns an empty result. This discards the parse error without any indication to the caller.

Edge case: A corrupted retransmission after completion would be silently ignored rather than triggering an abort or error, potentially masking network issues.

Impact: Reduced observability. The caller has no way to distinguish between 'no action needed' and 'malformed data received'.

Consideration: This may be intentional (after completion, ignore garbage) but the asymmetry with non-done state (which aborts) could confuse protocol implementers.

Suggested fix: Consider returning the original error wrapped in a 'no action needed' result, or add a comment explaining why silent discard is correct here.
